mode_forms.s_setreg_imm32_b32: hwreg(HW_REG_WAVE_MODE, 0|4, 4), imm (0 <= imm <= 0xF: immediate limited to the 4-bit field)
mode_forms.not_supported: VGPR_MSB, FP16_OVFL, SCALAR_PREFETCH_EN, REPLAY_MODE, FLAT_SCRATCH_IS_NV, DISABLE_PERF, any other hwreg or bit range, hwreg aliases (HW_REG_MODE, numeric ids), s_set_vgpr_msb

verifier_extra_wait_alu_encodings.0xfffe: literal encoding with only SA_SDST==0; accepted by the verifier, never emitted by the fuzzer

required_waits.P-GETREG-MODE-THEN-MODE-WRITE: a MODE write (s_setreg_b32, s_setreg_imm32_b32, s_round_mode, s_denorm_mode) after s_getreg_b32 MODE with no s_wait_alu whose SA_SDST field is 0 (all | sa_sdst) between them is outside the profile (mode_order UNKNOWN); generation inserts that wait

wrapper_forms: multiwave.Experiment.raw_lines: m1 prologue; v_readfirstlane_b32 s20, v0; s_lshr_b32 s20, s20, 5; s_barrier_signal -1; s_barrier_wait -1; evidence reads; role mask s24/s25; s_cmp_eq_u32 s25, 1; s_cbranch_scc1 .Laggressor; victim body + stores; s_branch .Ldone; aggressor body + stores; .Ldone: evidence read; s_wait_alu 0x0; v_mov_b32 v10..v13, v1; global_store_b128 v1, v[10:13], s[2:3] offset:4*evidence_base; s_endpgm
allowlist_canonical: sha256 of json.dumps({'body','pending','wrapper','control_only'} sorted lists, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=True)

wmma.operand_form: v_wmma_f32_16x16x32_bf16 v[D:D+7], v[A:A+7], v[B:B+7], v[C:C+7] (fuzzer tiles: A/B in v40, v48; C/D in v56, v64, v72); no modifiers
wmma.output_contract: A-WMMA-EXACT-REGIME: D element bits only when inputs are normal or zero and every partial sum is an exactly representable normal binary32 value (terms multiples of q >= 2^-126, sum of magnitudes < 2^24 q, D != 0); otherwise FLOATING_POINT_DERIVED (UNKNOWN)

hazards.W2: D -> VALU RAW/WAW, A/B/C <- VALU WAR: 4 slots (REJECT)
hazards.W3: D -> next WMMA C, XDL WAW/WAR (unlisted): 5 slots by conservative policy (UNKNOWN below)
hazards.W4: same-operand WMMA back-to-back without an intervening VALU/V_NOP (REJECT)
hazards.W5: slot = v_nop or a vector-ALU instruction touching none of the earlier WMMA registers; TRANS/WMMA do not count

wmma.gate: v_wmma_f32_16x16x32_bf16 stays in the campaign grammar only if the calibration WMMA op probe AGREES (not in calibration.json unmodeled_ops)
wmma.predecessor: none recorded (no predecessor kernel in this profile; launch contract predecessor_kernel null, assumption A-NO-PREDECESSOR)

evidence_forms.s_getreg_b32 s21, hwreg(HW_REG_WAVE_HW_I: whole HW_ID1, opaque (OPAQUE words); not a MODE access, never pending

multiwave.victims: victim bodies under the same body allowlist (FP/TRANS/f16 victims stay outside: fma_bystander, trans_stale, f16_halves)
multiwave.mode_ops: pending; multiwave calibration (calibrate-family) carries no ALU MODE op probes, so MODE ops stay disabled in verified multiwave campaigns unless a later change links them
multiwave.output_contract: raw-u32-mw: slot k of wave w lane l at word k*32W + 32w + l (exact; NOT_WRITTEN beyond the wave program slot count and for twin aggressors); evidence [HW_ID1, cycles start lo, cycles end lo, wave index] per wave: index exact, the other three OPAQUE
multiwave.same_address_store_lanes: ordered by lane (evidence store data is wave-uniform)
